extracted.intended_audience: students and readers of philosophy (epistemology/metaphysics), general educated readers
extracted.subtask_short: philosophy essay on ideas and space
extracted.subtask_description: Excerpt from John Locke's Essay Concerning Human Understanding analyzing how the mind forms complex ideas (modes, substances, relations) and a sustained treatment of the idea of space, extension, place, and related distinctions. Focus is conceptual analysis rather than prescriptive evaluation.
